`commandsRun[].result` must be exactly one of: passed, failed, not-run.
`manualNotes` and `notes` are optional strings; an empty string means no note and does not satisfy `manual-notes` evidence.

# DesktopPet Tools

## Concepts
- 本文件记录项目协作知识，不替代正式设计文档或当前代码。
- 真值优先级：`docs/` 正式文档（`windows-architecture.md` 为 Windows 版总纲）→ README.md → 当前代码。
- 双线结构：macOS 版（SwiftPM，根目录）与 Windows 版（`windows-native/`，.NET 8 + WPF）并存，改动前先确认目标平台。

## Read First
- `docs/windows-architecture.md` — Windows 版分层/模式/Provider/管道总纲
- `docs/windows-migration-plan.md` — Tauri → .NET 8 迁移路线与 Phase
- `docs/windows-ui-design.md` — Lumen 视觉与 UI 验收清单
- `docs/ai-personas.md` — 人格设计
- README.md — macOS 版功能与构建说明

## Tools
- macOS 构建/测试：`swift build` / `swift test`（CI：macos-15 + Xcode 16）
- macOS 打包：`./scripts/build-app.sh release`（产物 `build/DesktopPet.app`）；`./scripts/release.sh`、`./scripts/ci-dmg.sh` 为发布链路
- Windows 上验证 Swift 纯逻辑层：`./scripts/verify-core-windows.sh`（git-bash 下，绕过 SwiftPM bug）
- Windows .NET：`dotnet build DesktopPet.sln -p:Platform=x64`；测试项目：`tests/DesktopPet.Core.Tests` / `Infra.Tests` / `Agent.Tests` / `App.Tests`
- Windows 定向验收：`windows-native/scripts/phase6-*.ps1`（smoke/e2e/ui/模型连接/真实对话）；`perf-bench.ps1`（性能基线）
- 关键入口：macOS `Sources/App/DesktopPetApp.swift`；Windows `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App`（PetApp.exe）、`src/DesktopPet.AgentHost`（PetAgent.exe）、`src/DesktopPet.Agent`
- 配置/数据：Windows `%APPDATA%/DesktopPet/`（providers.json / logs/ / diary/）；`data/`（petdex 清单）；`Localizations/`（en/zh-Hans/zh-Hant/vi）

## Patterns
- 分层依赖方向：表现层（App）→ 应用层服务 → 领域层（Core）← 基础设施层（Infra）；Core 定义接口，Infra 实现，Core 零 UI 零 IO 可单测。
- Windows 渲染划分：宠物窗口/弹幕自绘渲染器（不走 MVVM），设置/对话 MVVM；新增高频渲染路径沿用此划分。
- Provider 抽象：模型/TTS/生图统一 OpenAI 兼容协议（一个 HttpClient 实现通吃云端与本地 Ollama/vLLM）。
- 对话请求管道：校验→人格拼接→记忆注入→屏幕上下文→模型调用→输出→token 记账→异步画像更新，每步独立可测。
- 迁移惯例：Tauri 旧版 `windows/` 已整体删除，旧 localStorage 数据迁移为 JSON 仓储（适配器一次性迁移）。

## Pitfalls
- Windows 上 `swift test` 会崩溃（SwiftPM llbuild job bug，见 swiftlang/swift-package-manager#6605），必须用 `./scripts/verify-core-windows.sh` 跑 54 个 core 测试。
- `windows-native/测试.txt` 含真实密钥，已被 .gitignore 忽略；不要读取、不要提交、不要解引用其内容。
- WebView2 透明窗口禁用硬件加速导致动画卡顿（旧 Tauri 版根因）——Windows 版已迁移原生渲染，不要再引入 Web 渲染路径。
- API Key 不得落明文 JSON：Windows 版存 Credential Manager，JSON 只存引用 ID。
- 模型请求并发受限流：用 SemaphoreSlim(3) 并发闸 + P0>P1>P2 优先级队列，对话 30s/互动 8s 超时。

text:
# DesktopPet 项目状态

> 本文件是当前状态快照 + 最近活跃窗口，允许覆盖更新。
> 完整历史归档见 `memory/archive/`，稳定规律见 `tools.md`。

## 当前基线
- macOS 主版（SwiftPM）：`swift build` / `swift test` 通过；打包 `./scripts/build-app.sh release`。
- Windows 版（.NET 8 + WPF）：`dotnet build DesktopPet.sln`（x64）通过。
- Windows 上 Swift core 验证：`./scripts/verify-core-windows.sh`（54 个 core 测试）。
- 最后更新：2026-08-06

## 已完成能力
- macOS 桌宠完整功能：养成（XP/五阶段/成就）、精灵导入切片、气泡、休息提醒、4 语言本地化、菜单栏应用 + Sparkle 更新。
- Windows .NET 8 + WPF 迁移全部完工，Tauri 旧版（`windows/`）已删除。
- Windows 版：宠物/漫游（stay/wander/cursor/climb 四策略）、气泡多行自适应、初始化引导（称呼+人格 onboarding）、分层会话记忆（L1 工作区 + L2 滚动摘要）、输出模式"仅聊天"（停 Agent、不后台截屏烧 token）、漫游设置中文化。
- Agent 屏幕分析评论为空问题已修复（推理模型思考吞 token 处理）。

## 进行中 / 未完成
- Roadmap 未启动项：v0.2 桌面感知（宠物感知当前应用）+ 本地/云端多模态对话；v0.3 每日总结 + 总结图。
- Windows 版待定决策（见 `docs/windows-architecture.md` §10）：Provider 默认实现范围、记忆画像字段清单、亲密度/XP 联动曲线、主动互动触发阈值、自动更新方案（Velopack vs 自建）。

## 关键决策（仍有效）
- Tauri → .NET 8 + WPF 整体迁移（透明窗口软渲染是卡顿根因，原生渲染是唯一合理选择）。
- 双进程架构：PetApp.exe + PetAgent.exe（截屏/分析/总结），Agent 崩溃看门狗自动重启。
- 模型/TTS/生图统一 OpenAI 兼容协议，Provider 可插拔；API Key 存 Windows Credential Manager，不落明文。
- 领域层（Core）零 UI 零 IO、可单测；宠物窗口自绘渲染器豁免 MVVM，设置/对话走 MVVM。
- AI 总开关：关闭即纯桌宠模式，无截屏/网络/后台进程。

## 仍需注意的坑点
- Windows 上 `swift test` 崩溃（SwiftPM llbuild bug #6605），core 测试必须走 `verify-core-windows.sh`。
- `windows-native/测试.txt` 含密钥，勿读取/提交。
- 模型请求限流：SemaphoreSlim(3) 并发闸 + 优先级队列，防云端 RPM/TPM 与本地 Ollama 雪崩。

## 最近活跃窗口
- 2026-08-05：删除 Tauri 旧版，.NET 8 + WPF 迁移全部完工。
- 2026-08-05：分层会话记忆（L1 工作区 + L2 滚动摘要）+ 输出模式"仅聊天"。
- 2026-08-05：初始化引导（称呼 + 人格选择）；漫游设置中文化。
- 2026-08-05：Agent 屏幕分析评论为空修复；气泡自适应多行显示。

> 初始内容参考了最近 8 条 git 提交（均为 2026-08-05 windows-native 工作），用于恢复近期项目状态。

- 模型/TTS/生图统一 OpenAI 兼容协议，Provider 可插拔；API Key 存 Windows Credential Manager，不落明文。
- 领域层（Core）零 UI 零 IO、可单测；宠物窗口自绘渲染器豁免 MVVM，设置/对话走 MVVM。
- AI 总开关：关闭即纯桌宠模式，无截屏/网络/后台进程。

## 仍需注意的坑点
- Windows 上 `swift test` 崩溃（SwiftPM llbuild bug #6605），core 测试必须走 `verify-core-windows.sh`。
- `windows-native/测试.txt` 含密钥，勿读取/提交。
- 模型请求限流：SemaphoreSlim(3) 并发闸 + 优先级队列，防云端 RPM/TPM 与本地 Ollama 雪崩。

## 最近活跃窗口
- 2026-08-05：删除 Tauri 旧版，.NET 8 + WPF 迁移全部完工。
- 2026-08-05：分层会话记忆（L1 工作区 + L2 滚动摘要）+ 输出模式"仅聊天"。
- 2026-08-05：初始化引导（称呼 + 人格选择）；漫游设置中文化。
- 2026-08-05：Agent 屏幕分析评论为空修复；气泡自适应多行显示。

> 初始内容参考了最近 8 条 git 提交（均为 2026-08-05 windows-native 工作），用于恢复近期项目状态。

arguments.command: nl -ba windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Windows/FloatingBallWindow.cs | sed -n '390,450p'; nl -ba windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Settings/SettingsWindow.cs | sed -n '220,300p'; nl -ba windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Settings/SettingsWindow.cs | sed -n '2380,2570p'

node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='windows-native/src/DesktopPet.Core/Resources/'; const names=['i18n.en.json','i18n.zh.json','i18n.zh-TW.json','i18n.vi.json']; const ds=Object.fromEntries(names.map(n=>[n,JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p+n))])); const en=Object.keys(ds[names[0]]); for(const n of names.slice(1)){const k=Object.keys(ds[n]); console.log(n,'keys',k.length,'missing',en.filter(x=>!(x in ds[n])).length,'extra',k.filter(x=>!(x in ds[names[0]])).length); if(k.filter(x=>!(x in ds[names[0]])).length) console.log(' extra',k.filter(x=>!(x in ds[names[0]])).slice(0,10));} const re=/\\{(\\d+)(?:[^}]*)\\}/g; const ph=s=>{let a=[],m; while((m=re.exec(s)))a.push(m[1]); return a.sort().join(',')}; for(const n of names.slice(1)){let bad=en.filter(k=>ph(ds[names[0]][k])!==ph(ds[n][k])); console.log(n,'placeholder mismatches',bad.length,bad.slice(0,20).map(k=>[k,ds[names[0]][k],ds[n][k]]));} for(const n of names.slice(1)){let same=en.filter(k=>ds[n][k]===ds[names[0]][k]); console.log(n,'same-as-English',same.length,same.slice(0,30));}"

## Review

- Correct: `LanguageCoordinator.ChangeLanguageAsync` persists settings before calling `_i18n.SetLang` and `_publish` at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Localization/LanguageCoordinator.cs:44-66`. The persistence-before-publication tests pass.
- Correct: Existing placeholder checks pass for keys present in the English catalog. AI prompts, model output, user text, and diagnostic log messages are generally kept outside the localization path in `AiCoordinator.cs`.
- Blocker: **English catalog is incomplete, causing widespread Chinese text in English UI.** `i18n.en.json` ends at line 347 and contains 345 keys, while `i18n.zh.json` contains 704 keys, `i18n.zh-TW.json` 709 keys, and `i18n.vi.json` 704 keys. The non-English catalogs contain 359, 364, and 359 keys respectively that are absent from English. For example, the current Settings surface uses `"我的宠物"` and `"添加宠物"` at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Settings/SettingsWindow.cs:823-840`, but these keys are absent from `i18n.en.json`. `I18nService.T` returns the key itself when English has no entry at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.Core/I18n/I18n.cs:54-67`, so English displays the Chinese source text. This violates English support and produces mixed-language pages.
- Important: **The completeness test cannot detect the missing English entries.** `I18nService.UiCatalogKeys` is derived exclusively from the English dictionary at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.Core/I18n/I18n.cs:77-80`; `I18nTests.UiCatalog_IsCompleteAcrossAllFourLanguages` only iterates that set at `windows-native/tests/DesktopPet.Core.Tests/I18nTests.cs:62-71`. Consequently, the 359/364 non-English-only keys are excluded from the assertion. Placeholder tests have the same blind spot for those keys.
- Important: **Language publication does not refresh every currently visible surface.** `App.PublishLanguage` only refreshes the manager, tray, and chat window at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/App.xaml.cs:503-511`. `PetWindowManager.ApplyLocalization` covers pet windows, floating ball, and Settings only at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Windows/PetWindowManager.cs:296-302`.
  - `WelcomeWindow` is created and shown as a local variable at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/App.xaml.cs:486-499`, has no `ApplyLocalization` method, and only applies translations once at construction at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Windows/WelcomeWindow.cs:35-157`.
  - An existing `DanmakuWindow` is retained inside `ModeService` at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Ai/ModeService.cs:25-30` and is created at `:80-85`, but there is no refresh call for it. It only applies localization during construction at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Windows/DanmakuWindow.cs:50-65`.
  - `SpritePreviewWindow` also only calls `WpfLocalizer.ApplyNew` during construction at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Windows/SpritePreviewWindow.cs:33-125` and has no refresh path. A visible preview or onboarding window can therefore retain the previous language after publication.
- Important: **Dynamic user/model content can be translated accidentally when it matches a catalog key.** `WpfLocalizer.Discover` treats every `TextBlock.Text` matching an English catalog key as localizable at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Localization/WpfLocalizer.cs:114-125` and later translates it at `:147-154`; `IsCatalogText` is only a catalog-membership check at `:178-181`. Settings passes dynamic values through this scanner:
  - User-controlled pet names are assigned directly to a `TextBlock` at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Settings/SettingsWindow.cs:911-920`.
  - Persona names and descriptions, including model/persona content, are assigned to `TextBlock`s at `:2252-2277`.
  - The completed page is scanned with `ApplyNew` at `:263-276`.
  
  For example, a user pet named `"设置"` matches the catalog key and is translated in non-Chinese locales. The current `WpfLocalizerTests` only verifies dynamic content added after the initial scan at `windows-native/tests/DesktopPet.App.Tests/WpfLocalizerTests.cs:10-27`, so it does not cover this collision.

- Residual native UI smoke gap: No Windows GUI smoke test was run for changing language while Welcome, Settings, Chat, FloatingBall, Danmaku, SpritePreview, Pet, and tray surfaces are simultaneously visible. The automated WPF tests run on STA and pass, but they do not validate real window lifetime, popup/menu ownership, tray rendering, Win2D/XAML Island behavior, or live language switching across all windows.
